issues.problem: out value 夜はいつも満席 is a bare noun: 満席はずがありません / 満席わけがありません are ill-formed (need の/な), so two distractors failed on form, not meaning.
issues.action: Replaced with 夜は予約が取りにくい / 'be hard to book in the evening'.

issues.problem: English for 毎晩遅くまで練習した read 'late into the night every day' (毎晩 = every night).
issues.action: Changed English to 'After practising until late every night'.

issues.problem: の was outside the slot, so distractors のに / には produced malformed strings (大雪ののに, 大雪のには) that a learner could reject on form alone.
issues.action: Moved の into the slot (のために); distractors now のように / なのに / の前に, all well-formed and wrong for 'because of'; why updated.
